versions.changelog: New icon. The shared helper keeps its connection file private, clears update records on the last disconnect, and keeps the network route you chose when an update check fails.
Balance and cost questions now answer from a live account read rather than from figures written into the package.

art-demo-set v0.1.1

- Introduces a workflow for generating one classroom art demo still per user-supplied drawing step.
- Adds clear instructions for collecting required input: lesson title, step titles, demo points, destination, and visual reference.
- Provides a free, labeled page plan before any charge, showing layout and content for each step.
- Ensures all generation calls use the bundled MCP client via specific commands, never REST/OpenAPI.
- Details review and delivery process, including polling and error recovery procedures.
- Clarifies automatic update safety and transparent upgrade mechanism for the bundled client.
